title: Choose the visual world
question: Experience-mode redesign for marcfors.com. The roll assigned Museum Product Vitrine (raised). Lock a world, take an alternate, re-roll, or take the category standard.

options.label: Museum Product Vitrine
options.thesis: Wordkeep sits in a museum case as the lead plate; Hire is a plaque action, App Store pending is the ribbon.
options.viewport: Full-bleed vitrine: Marc Fors + role on the plate, Wordkeep device object, pending ribbon, Hire CTA as plaque; work continues as the gallery below.
options.risk: Can slide into a generic product landing if the case is only decoration around a standard hero.

raised.raise: Discoverable depth: the case rewards closer looking — Wordkeep atlas detail appears when you lean in (select/focus), not as chrome clutter.
Structural honesty: proof (vitals, audit, CSP) reads as tension members holding the plate up, not a footer strip of badges.
One local interactive law: pointer/keyboard around the plate has a single physics — spotlight the object, never re-layout the desk.

options.label: Semantic Atlas
options.thesis: The portfolio is the living language graph; Wordkeep’s atlas leads the first viewport and Hire stays pinned in chrome.
options.viewport: Full-bleed atlas with selectable words; name + pending ribbon in a HUD; Hire in the header; legend strip starts the section below.
options.risk: Familiar for a language-product owner — strongest grounded pick, and where many runs would land.

options.label: Ukiyo-e Block Registration
options.thesis: The desk prints one color block at a time until Wordkeep and Hire register as a finished sheet.
options.viewport: Keyline sheet first; pigment layers arm in; Wordkeep plate registers; Hire lives in a vertical cartouche.
options.case: Strong craft identification; clarity holds if Hire stays a seal/cartouche, not buried in process theatre.
options.risk: Warm paper + craft serif can drift toward the cream-editorial default if pigments go timid.

options.label: Rhythm Machine Step Row
options.thesis: Shipped products are armed steps; Wordkeep is step one; Hire is RUN on the shared clock.
options.viewport: Instrument panel with sixteen-step product row; Wordkeep accented; chase light as scroll/now; Hire as RUN.
options.case: Best interactivity clarity of the hand; audience ID is instrument-geek, not every recruiter.
options.risk: Hardware costume can outshine product truth if the step row becomes a toy.

options.label: Algorave Source Floor
options.thesis: The page is a live buffer: Wordkeep and Hire edit on the next cycle boundary while proof stays audible.
options.viewport: Split stage: offer + live code buffer + pattern mixer; Hire on the downbeat; Wordkeep as lead pattern.
options.case: Highest identification for an LLM-agent engineer; clarity holds only if the offer stays human-readable beside the buffer.
options.risk: Neon black + green is a saturated AI-portfolio cluster — commitment must be the live clock, not glow.

options.label: Pixorama Metropolis
options.thesis: A zoomable pixel city of shipped products.
options.viewport: Zoomable product city with Wordkeep as a landmark block.
options.case: Loses both axes for recruiter hire clarity; jokes at deep zoom bury the offer.
options.kept: Discoverable depth discipline donated to the vitrine raise.

options.label: Tensegrity Column
options.thesis: Proof as opposing forces that make the portfolio stand.
options.viewport: Breathing force diagram as first viewport.
options.case: Loses Wordkeep story and recruiter clarity; too abstract for the product lead.
options.kept: Structural tension/compression honesty donated to the vitrine raise.

options.label: Gravity Rain Garden
options.thesis: Local gravity laws steer exploration of work.
options.viewport: Garden regions with local gravity toward projects.
options.case: Loses both axes for a hiring portfolio; surreal habitat obscures Wordkeep and Hire.
options.kept: One local interactive law donated to the vitrine raise.

canonCard.label: Category standard
canonCard.thesis: Dark recruiter portfolio with clear name, role, Wordkeep lead, and Hire — craft without a foreign world.
canonCard.viewport: Name + role + pending Wordkeep line + Hire; three equal work cards begin below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other AI-engineer portfolios by design.
